title: Prospective reviewer metadata (reviewer/metadata.json)
description: Closed, intentionally small reviewer-facing schema written by `miner prospective-export` as <bundle-root>/reviewer/metadata.json. Matches internal/prospectiveexport.Metadata and the allowlist in internal/prospectiveexport.ValidateNormalized exactly, and is a subset of the fields engine-runner's boundary validator permits: no field beyond this list may ever appear, and every included field must have passed cutoff-provenance validation before being written. Field values are additionally scanned engine-side for retrospective outcome language even inside an allowed field. See docs/export-contract.md §5 and engine-runner's docs/prospective-bundle-contract.md.

schema_version.description: Fixed contract version identifier. It pins the metadata contract independently of control/manifest.json, so a metadata file separated from its bundle is still self-identifying; the engine's boundary validator rejects any other value.

repository.description: owner/repo, copied from the selected correlated record's original.repository.

cutoff_timestamp.description: RFC3339Nano UTC benchmark-view cutoff, copied verbatim from the --cutoff argument.

title.description: Present only when the PR title as of cutoff is positively provable (unchanged since, or reconstructed via a complete rename history).

description.description: Present only when the PR body as of cutoff is positively provable (unchanged since cutoff); omitted otherwise because no complete body edit history is available.

base_branch.description: Present only when the base branch as of cutoff is positively provable (unchanged since cutoff).

commit_messages.description: Present only when PR commit membership was frozen by a merge at or before cutoff, the cached commit list is complete, and every commit has an admissible (<= cutoff) timestamp.
